text:
min_park: Canary perf spike after runtime-lib 1.9.2 -> 1.10.0. Token latency +10-15% for 512/1k sequences on h100 pools.
sara_eng: saw it too. traces show kernel switch from attn_fused_v1 -> attn_generic for 80% of requests.
ryan_runtime: interesting — autotuner logs:
```
[autotune] input_len=512 chosen=attn_generic score=0.880
[autotune] input_len=512 prev=attn_fused_v1 score=0.125
```
ryan_runtime: looks like heuristic weights shifted after cuDNN/driver change; kernel entropy increased.
leila_prod: KV cache hitrate dropped ~4% concurrently (see profiler: /mnt/artifacts/1934567890/kv_hitrate.png)
sara_eng: reduced batching efficiency too — batch packing dropped because of per-request latency jitter.
min_park: can we pin the kernel while we investigate? I can push env pin to canary.
ryan_runtime: yes — we have runtime flag: `REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL=attn_fused_v1`. set it in canary nodes or per-model override.
min_park: command I ran:
```
redwoodctl nodes update --env=canary --set=env.REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL=attn_fused_v1
```
deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime-config update for canary (id: d-9837)
ops_alert_bot: note: changing kernel pin will bypass autotuner; monitor for tail-latency regression.
sara_eng: proposed rollback plan:
- step 1: pin kernel in canary (fast)
- step 2: roll runtime-lib back to 1.9.2 for canary using `redwoodctl deploy rollback` if pin doesn't stabilize
- step 3: gather detailed perf diffs (kernels, cuDNN versions, heuristics) and open bug with vendor if necessary
- step 4: after fix, gradually re-enable autotune behind canary toggle
ryan_runtime: I attached a short profiler dump (attn kernel timings) in artifacts. I'll run a focused AB test comparing pinned vs autotune for 10k reqs.
leila_prod: also consider temporary routing policy: route low-latency customers to dedicated cluster with old runtime until resolved.
min_park: agreed. I'll pin canary now and start the rollback doc.
sara_eng: thanks. tag me when AB finishes. :thumbsup:
